messages:
alex: Heads-up — FinOps dashboard popped a 42% jump in per-GPU cost yesterday for gpu-prod-usw2. Suspect billing misattribution or cross-region egress. I exported the top-line rows below. Can infra/SRE help validate?

maria: On it. PDF of the dashboard? link: https://redwood.prod/finops/dashboards/gpu-util

samir: I pulled the allocation table. There's a big batch of traffic tagged as "unlabeled" that maps to our batch-encoder model. Could be missing billing tags when instances spin up. Query I ran:
```
SELECT resource_id, SUM(cost) as cost, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT labels) FROM `billing.gcp_exports` 
WHERE project = 'redwood-prod' AND date = '2026-02-12' GROUP BY resource_id ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Results: resource_id=instance-ml-enc-03 cost=$19,200 labels=[]

billing-bot: Automated alert: cost anomaly detected in project redwood-prod — +42% GPU spend (24h). Ticket: BF-1028 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

jess: If instances are missing our billing tags they fall back to on-demand pools and show up as unlabeled. That would explain the cost hit and why the reserved commitment didn't cover it. Can we confirm whether autoscaler applied a launchTemplate without the tag?

li: I saw autoscaler logs. There's a bad merge in the infra repo where a default launch template lost the `env=redwood` tag for the ml node pool in us-west-2. Log snippet:
```
2026-02-12T03:12:07Z autoscaler: launching instance i-0a1b2c3d template=ml-large-v2 tags={} zone=us-west-2a
```
I'll roll a patch to restore tags and backfill where feasible. :hammer_and_wrench:

samir: Also looks like routing policy sent some encoder requests to a dedicated spot pool in another region for a short window — that caused inter-region egress. We're seeing double-billing (compute + egress). I can isolate the window: 03:10–03:40 UTC.

alex: OK owners: @li fix launch template and backfill tagging (do a dry run). @samir provide precise resource list for invoice dispute. @jess run reconciliation with billing team and start a credits request. Maria - can you adjust the FinOps dashboard to show per-route egress so we can spot this faster?

maria: Yup. I'll add a per-route egress series and a filter for unlabeled resources. Quick SQL for dashboard metric I'm adding:
```
SUM(CASE WHEN label IS NULL THEN egress_bytes * egress_rate ELSE 0 END)
```
ETA ~2h.

jess: I'll open a billing dispute with cloud support and flag the commitment team. If dispute goes through we might get a one-off credit; long-term we should tighten reservation coverage and add preflight validation on launch templates.

alex: Nice. Can we also produce a short runbook for FinOps alerts so on-call knows to check tags + inter-region egress first? Samir, can you draft?

samir: Will do. Draft by EOD and schedule a 30m sync with infra/billing tomorrow. Thanks.

li: Patch pushed to infra repo, rolling to canary. I'll post deploy ts when done.

billing-bot: Ticket BF-1028 updated: assignees=jess,samir,li; status=in_progress

alex: Great — follow-ups in thread. :eyes:
